svg.text: Layout A · one floating bar above the nav: search pill plus round filter button; hides on scroll down
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915, synthetic data only. Issue #32: bottom search and filter button instead of the chip row.
1 · PRs at rest, no filters
One floating bar 16px above the nav. Wide search pill,
round filter button at its right. No badge with no
filters. Header keeps only the ··· menu.
2 · PRs, 2 filters active
Needs me and Mine are on. The filter button shows a badge
of 2. The list keeps its sections; other sections drop
out.
3 · Filter sheet open

g.text: Rows combine: a PR shows if it matches any.

svg.text: Tapping the filter button opens a bottom sheet. Each chip
from today becomes a checkbox row with its count. Clear
resets; Done closes.
4 · Search active
Tapping the pill moves it up to sit on the keyboard.
Results replace the list and fill the space above. Cancel
clears and drops the keyboard.
5 · Scrolled down
Scrolling down slides the bar away so rows reach the nav.
Any scroll up brings it back. The header collapses as
built in #31.
6 · Issues tab at rest

g.text: Sync line shows stale API count
Order export drops the vendor id
Add retry budget to the client
Crash when the token is revoked

svg.text: Same bar on Issues. The sheet lists the Issues chips: In
progress, Assigned, Created, Mentioned, Untriaged and the
bot section.

Layout A: a single floating bar holds both search and filter, so the two related actions sit together in thumb reach. It slides away on scroll down to give rows the full height and returns on scroll up. The nav
keeps three tabs.

Setup: every frame is a 412x915 Android phone with the status bar at the top and the bottom nav (PRs / Issues / Activity with badges) at the bottom. The large-title header from #31, the sync line, section headers
and rows stay as they are today; #33, #34 and #39 change those later. The chip row is gone on phone, which removes the horizontal scroll and the cut-off last chip.

Header search button: removed in both layouts. The bottom control is the one way into search, and it sits in thumb reach; keeping both would give two entry points in different places. The ··· menu stays.

Filter sheet rows come from the real chip sets in web/phone/phone-logic.ts. PRs: Needs me, Mine, Org, Dependabot. Issues: In progress, Assigned, Created, Mentioned, Untriaged, plus the bot section when present. The
badge counts rows that are on; All is the state with none on.
Sample data only: repos acme-co/orders-api and acme-dev/tools; authors acme-dev, build-bot and sam-lee. Greyscale labelled boxes, minimum 12px text, no colour or styling.
